description: Header file defining the VertexArrayVk class, which implements Vulkan-specific vertex array functionality for ANGLE's renderer. It includes class declarations, member variables, and method signatures related to vertex array management in Vulkan.

classes.name: VertexArrayVk
classes.description: Vulkan-specific implementation of vertex array object, managing buffer bindings, attribute states, and related operations.
